olivia: Quick questionI'm retiring 2026-12-01 and want to rollover my 401(k) to an IRA. I also had a limited-purpose FSA this year and want to understand grace period/claim deadlines. Any timing issues with final pay, COBRA, or outstanding loan I should know about?

matt: Congrats! :tada: High level: direct trustee-to-trustee rollover avoids the 60-day rule. FSA depends on plan year & grace/runout period. Loan: if unpaid at termination it can be treated as a distribution.

benefitsbot: PlanAdmin policy: "Direct rollovers permitted. For terminated participants, outstanding loan balances not cured per plan terms will be reported as distributions. Health FSA grace/runout periods vary by plan; claims must be incurred by plan rules. COBRA offers continuation of medical, dental, vision but not employer HSA contributions."

sara: Actionable dates for you: 1) Submit rollover distribution form to PlanAdmin by 2026-12-15 to initiate trustee transfer. 2) If you have an FSA runout period (usually 90 days) submit claims by 2027-03-31 if your plan uses calendar-year + 90-day runout — check your plan doc. 3) If you have a loan, pay PlanAdmin via ACH or request final paycheck withholding before final payroll cutoff.

olivia: My loan is small (~$1,750). Final payroll is 2026-11-30 (run date 12/01). How do I set withholding?

matt: Email payroll@redwood with subject "LOAN WITHHOLD AUTH - olivia". Include LoanID, amount, and signature. Must be submitted before payroll cutoff (2026-11-29 EOD) so system can add the deduction.

frank: Note on COBRA/HSA: if you elect COBRA for medical, HSA contributions stop after termination unless employer agrees otherwise. You can still contribute to an HSA when on COBRA if the COBRA plan is HSA-eligible, but employer contributions typically end. For limited-purpose FSA (dental/vision), eligible claims follow plan runout.

olivia: If I do a direct rollover to Vanguard IRA, can I convert to Roth there? Any withholding?

sara: You can do a direct rollover to a traditional IRA and then do a Roth conversion at the IRA custodian. That conversion is taxable; no mandatory withholding on a trustee-to-trustee direct rollover. If PlanAdmin issues a distribution payable to you, 20% federal withholding applies to eligible rollover distributions.

benefitsbot: Automated note: LoanID 771900, balance $1,750, orig date 2025-05-14. FSA plan type: Limited-purpose dental/vision, plan year calendar-year, runout 90 days. COBRA notice will be emailed within 14 days after termination.

olivia: Thanks  I'll send payroll the LOAN WITHHOLD AUTH and submit the rollover form to PlanAdmin. One last Q: do I need to inform benefits if I elect COBRA and also do rollover?

matt: No special coupling. Rollover is handled by PlanAdmin/your IRA custodian. COBRA is benefits/legal. Just make sure you keep copies of forms and confirm PlanAdmin posts the rollover so your 401(k) balance doesn't sit as an open distribution.

olivia: Got it. I'll post when completed. Appreciate the help!
